title: Largest Subarray Length K
summary: Given an array of distinct integers, determine the largest subarray of length k, where 'largest' is defined by comparing the first differing element in the subarrays.
statement: Given an array of distinct integers, determine the largest subarray of length k, where 'largest' is defined by comparing the first differing element in the subarrays.
constraints: nums contains distinct integers and 1 <= k <= len(nums).
Among contiguous length-k slices, return the lexicographically largest.
hints: Distinct values make the first element alone decide between any two candidate slices.
Choose the maximum start value among indices that leave k elements.
Search starts 0 through n-k, then return nums[start:start+k].
Every pair of candidate slices differs immediately because their first elements come from distinct indices with distinct values.
editorial: Every pair of candidate slices differs immediately because their first elements come from distinct indices with distinct values.

tests.explanation: Eligible starts are one, four, and five; the slice starting at five is 5,2,3.
Only starts one and four fit; 4,5,2,3 is larger.
